title: Chapter 761 Change In Situation; Celebration!

Chapter 761 Change In Situation; Celebration!

Chapter 761  Change in Situation; Celebration!

The leader of the demon race and the other demons cried like rain.

Part of the reason was due to the influence of heaven and earth.

The most important reason was that he was too domineering…This demon ancestor had died!

The demon race had been a powerful race for countless years.

That was because they had a rich foundation.

This was because they had the Holy Lord Patriarch.

Now, his foundation had been stolen.

The ancestor died.

What should the future of the Monster Race be like?

Countless images flashed in the minds of the demons.

Her tears became even more intense.

The demons felt that the future was bleak.

....

Compared to the demons 'frustration.

The Holy Lords were terrified.

That was because, in their impression, the Holy Master was invincible and could never die.

However, this impression had been shattered.

A Sacred Lord was dead!

Furthermore, it was an extremely powerful Fey Sacred Lord!

The Holy Lords could not help but look towards the location of the Buddha Realm.

During this period of time, they also knew that Bodhi Guo had been cursing Tyrant.

Now, he was cursed to death?

Just how strong was the Bodhi Fruit?

If he could curse Tai Ba to death, could he also curse himself to death?

Worry and a ferocious aura spread around the Saint Lords.

Especially the Sacred Lord of the Sea, Bo Han!

All along, he had been suffering from the Bodhi Fruit's curse.

For this reason, they had no choice but to start a war with the Buddha Realm.

Both sides could be said to be fighting to the death.

What should he do now?

Bo Han's expression kept changing, no one knew what he was thinking.

....

Buddha Realm.

The Buddha Realm, which was always filled with Buddhist voices, was now silent.

The Buddhas raised their heads and looked at the Bodhi Fruit with complicated expressions.

Bodhi Guo was the Buddha Realm's Holy Lord, the ancestor of all Buddhas, and an existence revered by all the Great Buddhas.

At this moment, the eyes of the buddhas that were looking at the Bodhi Fruit were filled with fear and terror.

That was because the Bodhi Fruit had actually 'killed' a Sacred Master!

This represented too many things.

What would the other Holy Masters think?

More importantly, did the Sacred Lord Bodhi Fruit really possess such power?

Finally, a buddha could not help but say,"Did you just kill Tai Ba?"

All the Buddhas pricked up their ears.

They were all filled with anticipation and curiosity.

"No." Bodhi Guo shook his head.

He was also very helpless.

Why did everyone think that he was the one who had been cursing or even killing Tai Ba?

How many times had he explained to Tai Ba?

Why didn't he believe it?

He even roared before he died.

This was great. What would the other Holy Masters think of him?

Bodhi Guo put himself in his shoes.

If he had known that there was such a person who could curse and kill him, he would definitely not have let him exist in the world.

Thinking of this, the Bodhi Fruit could not help but feel a chill.

His strength could be ranked at the forefront among the many Sacred Lords.

However, the key was that it was difficult for two fists to fight against four hands.

If they attacked together, how could he resist?

Bodhi Fruit expressed that he was very square.

....

Earth.

Lin Fan took a step out after comprehending his current strength and returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, and the others were shocked by what happened earlier.

Now that they saw Lin Fan, they all ran over.

"Lin Fan!"

"Are you alright?"

Their faces were filled with worry.

Lin Fan said," Don't worry, I'm fine.""

Hearing Lin Fan's relaxed tone, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

Hu Tian said,"Lin Fan, you seem to be…" You became stronger again?"

"Yes, I made some breakthroughs."  Lin Fan said," Now, we can relax for a long time."

When everyone heard this, the smiles on their faces widened.

On that day, the Coiling Dragon Villa held a very sumptuous bonfire party. There were skewers and fine wine. The fragrance assailed the nostrils and it was very lively.

Everyone ate happily.

The night gradually deepened.

Lin Fan, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, Kailin and the rest walked into the room.

....

Time flowed like water.

In the blink of an eye, 100 years had passed.

Just as Lin Fan said, they could relax for a long time.

In the past 100 years, they did not deliberately spend a long time cultivating.

Every day, they lived a life where they only envied mandarin ducks and not immortals.

However, even so, Lin Fan's cultivation state was still increasing by relying on the Ethereal Breathing Technique that had been upgraded to Saint King Grade. In addition, he had also obtained Saint Grade Spirit Stones, Great Dao Fragments, and other treasures from the system over the past hundred years.

In just a hundred years, Lin Fan had already entered the intermediate stage of the Holy Lord Realm.

In fact, he had even walked a long distance to the middle stage of the Sacred Lord Realm.

....

In the outside world, it was completely different from the peaceful time in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Due to Tai Ba's fall, the demons lost their protective umbrella, and many enemies began to take revenge.

For a moment, the demons became the meat in everyone's eyes.

As for the Buddha Realm, without the attack of the demons, it was relatively peaceful for the first few decades.

However, sometimes, calmness was the sign of a storm.

70 years later, the Ocean World, the Divine World, the Other World, the Demon World, and many other worlds attacked the Buddha World together.

Even the powerful Buddha Realm could not resist such a grand attack. They could only retreat and hide.

Bodhi Fruit had paid a huge price and finally reached an agreement with the many, promising to avoid the battle.

When Bodhi Guo returned to the Buddha Realm, he only felt physically and mentally exhausted.

He had been too tired all these years.

....

It was also today…

Under Lin Fan's hard work, a trace of life force suddenly appeared in Kailin's stomach.

"Heavens! Kathleen, you're pregnant!"

"There really is!"

"That's great. It won't be long before our Coiling Dragon Villa has a new member!"

The Coiling Dragon Villa was filled with jubilation. Everyone was silent in joy.

Among them, Kailin was the most outstanding.

She gently caressed her belly and felt the life force that was emitting from it. Her entire face was like a blooming flower, extremely brilliant.

"Is this the feeling of giving birth to life? Really... This is amazing."

Lin Fan was very happy that he was about to have another child.

If he was happy, he had to celebrate.

He suddenly remembered that he still had an enemy who hadn't died, and that was Bo Han.

Since that was the case, he would curse him and celebrate.

[Do you want to spend 100 million Spiritual Stones to curse Bo Han?]

"Yes, sir!"

[Do you want to spend 100 million Spiritual Stones to curse Bo Han?]

"Yes, sir!"

[Do you want to spend 100 million Spiritual Stones to curse Bo Han?]

"Yes, sir!"

....

Another 10 curses.

Only then did it end.

At this moment, in the Ocean World.

Bo Han sat on the main seat and closed the door.

He muttered in his heart,'I've finally reached an agreement with the Bodhi Fruit. The power of the curse has been decreasing over the past hundred years. It shouldn't be long before it completely dissipates.'"

Then, he sighed again.

When had he, the dignified Holy Lord of the Ocean, ever treated others as if they were snakes?

However, Tai Ba's death had a huge impact on him.

It made him afraid.

This was why when many forces were dealing with the Buddha Realm, they took the initiative to show goodwill to the Bodhi Fruit and urged the final ceasefire.

Otherwise, how could the war in the Buddha Realm end so quickly?
